verdict.rationale: Lago's docs mention a generic 'revenue-analytics' page with custom dashboards, filters, and CSV export (lago-docs-15), which is closer to the bolted-on BI export the story explicitly wants to avoid, not native MRR/churn/cohort-retention/LTV computation. No evidence pack item shows Lago computing these specific metrics natively from billing data, and a community question in lago-comm-3 explicitly asks whether Lago handles revenue recognition, left unanswered.
